title: Income-tax Act, 1961: TDS/TCS sections, FY 2025-26 rates and thresholds, and Protean 1961 statement codes
applies_to: Payments up to 31 March 2026 (FY 2025-26 and earlier); later FYs may differ, earlier FYs certainly differ in places (for example Finance Act 2025 threshold changes from 1 April 2025).

field_notes.sections: Rate chart by 1961 section for FY 2025-26. rate_percent is before surcharge and cess.
field_notes.protean_codes: Codes Protean uses in 24Q/26Q/27Q/27EQ (from form1961Codes.ts). mapping_basis says how section_1961 was found.
